#include <iostream>

int main() {
    int w, n;
    std::cin >> w >> n;

    bool ok = true;
    while (n != 0) {
        int r = n % w;
        if (r == 0 || r == 1) {
            n /= w;
        } else if (r == w - 1) {
            n = n / w + 1;
        } else {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
